name: Tracy Aviary Conservation Fund
summary: Annual short-term grants for avian conservation projects that can deliver measurable results in one to two years. Project categories include data collection and monitoring, conservation action, species assistance and habitat restoration.

status.quote: We are now accepting proposals, due November 15, 2026.

deadline.quote: We are now accepting proposals, due November 15, 2026.

applicant_types.quote: Nonprofit organizations, public and private educational organizations, federal, state, local agencies and tribal governments are encouraged to apply.

access.quote: We are now accepting proposals, due November 15, 2026.

window.quote: We provide annual short-term grants of up to $10,000 to support avian conservation projects that require 1-2 years of effort and accomplish short-term goals and measurable successes.
